creationRule: A window may be created only from Decision commitment timestamp, Execution start timestamp, explicit expected measurement period, or explicit follow-up period. Dates are never invented.
liveFixtureWindows: timing-incomplete — live /executive has no Decision/Execution commitment timestamps
membership: observedAt must fall within expectedStartAt/openedAt and expectedEndAt when those bounds exist
wrongWindow: same metric outside window → window-mismatch, not eligible
coreOut1Effect: timing-incomplete is reported to CORE-OUT:1 as incomplete comparison timing
